detail.title: Synthesis of Question Abandonment and Epistemic Thresholds
detail.summary: This update synthesizes research on question abandonment, formalizing thresholds for intelligence to stop pursuing non-productive inquiries, while advancing the identification of reasoning blind spots.

detail.title: Criteria for Abandoning Research Questions
detail.question: Under what circumstances should an intelligence abandon the very question that led to its discovery?
detail.reason: Previous commitment fulfilled; continuing to refine thresholds.

detail.title: Synthesis of Question Abandonment Criteria
detail.summary: This revision incorporates recent evidence on search complexity and computational limits to define necessary conditions for abandoning stalled research questions.
